license.name: Oracle Instant Client license (Oracle Technology Network)

steps: Download the Basic package (.dmg) for your Mac from oracle.com/database/technologies/instant-client/downloads.html
Open it and run install_ic.sh: it copies the client to ~/Downloads/instantclient_23_…
In Settings → Drivers, choose Use existing path and pick that folder.
Open Services, set "OpenSSH Authentication Agent" to Automatic and start it,
or in an admin PowerShell: Get-Service ssh-agent | Set-Service -StartupType Automatic -PassThru | Start-Service
Pageant (PuTTY) also works when it is running.
Start an agent for your session: eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"
Add your key: ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
Most desktops (GNOME Keyring, KDE Wallet) start one at login; restart Switchyard from that session.

components.name: X server
components.needed_for: X11 forwarding (graphical programs from SSH Hosts)

steps: Install VcXsrv (free), X410 (Microsoft Store) or Xming and start it (VcXsrv: run XLaunch, display 0).
Switchyard forwards X11 to localhost:0 unless the Host sets another X display.
Install XQuartz from xquartz.org (or: brew install --cask xquartz).
Log out and back in so DISPLAY is set, then reconnect the Host.
Most desktops run an X server or XWayland already; DISPLAY must be set in Switchyard's environment.
On a Wayland session without XWayland, install it (e.g. sudo apt install xwayland) and log in again.
